newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank Slaski soars on buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Bank Slaski soars on buy recommendation.

text.p: Poland's Bank Slaski SA surged 9.9 percent to 359.5 zlotys in the session's heaviest turnover to its highest level since 1994, helped by a buy recommendation from a Polish brokerage, analysts said.
"The recommendation definitely has something to do with the rise," one trader said. Turnover was at 9.3 million zlotys.

In a December 20 report, released on Monday, the brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA recommended investors buy shares of Slaski, saying they were likely to rise to between 400 and 450 zlotys in the longer term.
Some analysts said the stock was likely to fall slightly in profit-taking or stabilise in the next few sessions.
